policy.run_selection: Only runs/sac_revision_* with complete.json and matching configured/completed episodes.
policy.evaluation: Final development and named holdouts copied in full; earlier development files are explicitly derived summaries without hourly payloads.
policy.frozen_source: Byte-for-byte; manifest hashes checked first. Caches, checkpoints and source-document/media formats excluded.
policy.literature: Metadata/provenance only. No PDF, XML, raw excerpts, images or supplement archives.
policy.analysis: Generated JSON/PNG from the two named final analysis directories and final evaluation/test records are copied byte-for-byte. The image exception does not apply to literature source images.
policy.diagnostics: Explicit response-probe script/JSON allowlist only; intermediate trial *_analysis.json files are excluded because they can be regenerated from retained final development evaluations.
policy.probe_execution: Probe scripts preserved byte-for-byte. Restore to original checks/sac_revision paths before running scripts whose ROOT depends on parents[2].
policy.README: Not generated or modified by this script.
policy.manifest_self_hash: This manifest cannot include its own content hash; all copied and other derived managed files are listed below.

files.derivation: Preserve original audit metadata/hash records; explicitly distinguish distributed metadata from excluded local source material and record current copied-file hashes.
